in_hebrew.name: Erastatus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Erastatus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Erasmos' meaning 'beloved', 'dear' or 'gracious'. The Roman name 'Erastus' means 'earnest' or 'eager'. In the Bible, Erastus is mentioned as the treasurer of the church in Corinth.

in_greek.name: Erastatus
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Beloved, Earnest
in_greek.long_meaning: Erastatus είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Erasmos' meaning 'beloved', 'dear' or 'gracious'. The Roman name 'Erastus' means 'earnest' or 'eager'. In the Bible, Erastus is mentioned as the treasurer of the church in Corinth.

in_latin.name: Erastatus
in_latin.meaning: Natus in amor, amans natus, amabilis, carus, dilectus
in_latin.long_meaning: Natus in amor, nomen significans amoris et affinitatem, Erastatus est nomen viri qui in amore suo proficiscitur. Originem trahit a verbo Graeco Υ
